mapper.select: SELECT * FROM system_config ORDER BY config_group, id ASC
SELECT * FROM system_config WHERE config_group = #{configGroup} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT * FROM system_config WHERE config_group = #{configGroup} AND config_key = #{configKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_config (config_group, config_key, config_value, `description`, `sensitive`, value_type, default_value) VALUES (#{configGroup}, #{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{description}, #{sensitive}, #{valueType}, #{defaultValue}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE config_value = #{configValue}, `description` = #{description}, `sensitive` = #{sensitive}, value_type = #{valueType}, default_value = #{defaultValue}, update_time = NOW()

INSERT INTO system_config (config_group, config_key, config_value, `description`, `sensitive`, value_type, default_value) VALUES
(#{item.configGroup}, #{item.configKey}, #{item.configValue}, #{item.description}, #{item.sensitive}, #{item.valueType}, #{item.defaultValue})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE config_value = VALUES(config_value), `description` = VALUES(`description`), `sensitive` = VALUES(`sensitive`), value_type = VALUES(value_type), default_value = VALUES(default_value), update_time = NOW()
